description: Source code for the Android shared video decoder implementation in the Cobalt project, including classes and functions for handling video decoding, surface textures, and media format parsing.

classes.name: VideoFrameImpl
classes.description: Implementation of VideoFrame that manages output buffer release and drawing.

classes.name: VideoRenderAlgorithmTunneled
classes.description: Video render algorithm for tunneled mode, managing frame tracking and seeking.

classes.name: VideoDecoder::Sink
classes.description: Implementation of VideoRendererSink that renders frames and manages callbacks.

classes.name: VideoDecoder
classes.description: Main class handling video decoding, surface management, format parsing, and frame output.

methods.name: IsSoftwareDecodeRequired
methods.description: Determines if software decoding is required based on max video capabilities string.

methods.name: ParseMaxResolution
methods.description: Parses maximum resolution from max_video_capabilities string.

methods.name: GetCurrentDecodeTarget
methods.description: Returns the current decode target in decode-to-texture mode.

methods.name: UpdateDecodeTargetSizeAndContentRegion_Locked
methods.description: Updates size and content region of the decode target based on current frame sizes.

methods.name: SetDecodeTargetContentRegionFromMatrix
methods.description: Converts a texture transform matrix into a content region rectangle.
